column1: # Tatoeba sentences the site never shows, as an example or in grammar practice.
# No native speaker reads the sentences before they are shown, so a sentence that a dictionary for
# learners should not carry is listed here by hand. The trigger: the grammar card for дякувати showed
# "Путін у новорічну ніч подякував росіянам за готовність відстоювати інтереси країни".
# Listed: praise of or propaganda for a regime, slurs and sweeping claims about a people or a faith,
# insults aimed at a named politician, contested claims stated as fact, and profanity. Not listed:
# sentences that are neutral, factual or critical (Росія вторглася в Україну), however political.
# Candidates come from `python3 data/rate_sentences.py screen data/raw --db nebokrai.db` (or --all),
# which lists sentences by keyword group; a person decides each one. A match alone excludes nothing.
# One line per sentence, three columns separated by tabs:
#   id       the Tatoeba id of the Ukrainian sentence (https://tatoeba.org/sentences/show/<id>)
#   group    the screen group it came from (russia, ukraine-war, soviet, politicians, faith-people,
#   reason   why it is left out, in a few words, and who decided it and when
# import_wiktionary.py, add_examples.py and add_cloze.py drop every listed id; tests/excluded.test.ts
# checks that none is in nebokrai.db. Lines starting with # are comments.
